title: Property transactions — Nolan Farms
instructions: Kurt Nolan, a sole proprietor, had the 2025 transactions below. All business assets were held more than one year. He has $10,000 of nonrecaptured net §1231 losses from 2022. Enter losses as negative numbers.

exhibits.title: Exchange
exhibits.content: Kurt exchanged investment land (basis $100,000; FMV $250,000) for a rental building worth $230,000 plus $20,000 cash.
